messages:
maria: Dropping a new concept for the Usage page: "compact three-up" layout for org scope. Goal: fit more projects above the fold while keeping invoice download obvious. Mock: https://figma.com/... feedback wanted on affordances, accessibility, and perf tradeoffs. jonah: Looks promising for power users. Concern: the per-project token list gets visually noisy when compressed. Suggest a micro-toggle that reveals detailed rows inline rather than a full modal. rebecca: perf FYI 10 projects with full histograms = ~400ms backend + heavier payloads. We should default to compressed sparklines + fetch detail on demand. Consider using an IntersectionObserver trigger at 250px and keyboard focus to kick off requests. sam-a11y: a11y checklist: compact grid must still preserve DOM order for linear reading. Each project card should expose role="article" with aria-labelledby. Important: error/warning colors don't meet 4.5:1 contrast in current mock; increase luminance or add outlines. maria: good points. @jonah outline the micro-toggle UI? inline chevron or small link? jonah: micro-toggle = inline "Show tokens" button (small, tertiary). When expanded, insert a light table with token rows. ARIA: `aria-controls` + `aria-expanded`. Example snippet: ```html
...
``` rebecca: backend: add lightweight endpoint /projects/:id/usage-summary returning totals + mini-spark. /projects/:id/usage-detail returns day-level tokens. Add query param prefetch=focus to allow client-initiated load. We'll paginate invoice line items. leah: CS asks that the invoice download be discoverable after scope changes. Propose pinning a primary CTA in the page header (scope-aware) and a small per-card CSV link labeled "Download invoice (CSV)". Also request copy to mention format and timeframe. oliver: product call: keep header CTA as canonical; per-card link is convenience. Track both clicks with same event name plus scope_id and project_id to avoid analytics duplication. maria: keyboard nav: should arrow keys move between cards or tabs? Sam? sam-a11y: recommend roving tabindex with arrow navigation inside the grid, plus tab to move out of grid. Announce expand/collapse with live region text. Also ensure focus styles are visible in reduced padding layout. jonah: design tweaks: drop horizontal padding to 10px, use 14pt medium for cost, muted secondary text for token counts. Delta indicator: use both color and chevron direction to avoid color-only cues. rebecca: measure impact: baseline metrics = page TTFB, avg time-to-interact, invoice-download conversion. For experiment, gate full histograms behind expansion to keep initial payload small. deploy-bot: deploy check: flagged assets - please ensure feature flag `compact-usage-grid` is added. leah: I'll draft support blurb for customers and suggested troubleshooting steps if invoices appear missing after scope switch. maria: plan to prototype this variant to 3% of orgs. Ramp if metrics stable. Target: prototype mock by Wed, dev spike Thu, experiment in 2 weeks. Any objections? oliver: none. +1 to experiment window. rebecca: I'll stub APIs and add prefetch guidelines in the spec. Ping me for contract review. jonah: I'll upload updated frames and keyboard flow diagrams. :thumbsup: maria: thanks all if no blockers I'll lock requirements end of day.
